headline: JPMorgan Wins Approval-in-Principle for Nigerian Merchant Bank
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria granted JPMorgan Merchant Bank Nigeria approval-in-principle to operate a merchant bank, pending final regulatory licensing.
why: JPMorgan Chase is the largest US commercial bank; establishing merchant banking in Nigeria broadens corporate advisory and trade finance across West Africa.

impacts.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co
impacts.why: Merchant bank licensing allows JPMorgan to conduct direct investment banking, underwriting, and wholesale banking in Nigeria.
